_about: Demo accounts for POST /api/auth/login. Passwords are PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, 200000 iterations, unique 16-byte salt per account. The plaintext passwords are published in README.md because this build guards a synthetic corpus and a judge needs to be able to sign in. Replace this file with a real directory service before any deployment; backend/auth/credentials.py is the only module that reads it.
